course_name_original: Aufbaumodul Entwicklung und Betrieb von Informationssystemen
course_name_en: Advanced Module Development and Operation of Information Systems
prerequisites: Competencies taught in the basic modules for Practical Computer Science are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have basic knowledge and skills in the development and operation of information systems
know the theoretical principles of the development and operation of information systems as well as selected applications
are able to apply working methods from business informatics
are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion

syllabus_topics: Process models for the development of information systems

assessment_methods.method: Written exam or oral examination (individual examination)

assessment_rules: To acquire ECTS, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved. Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points, according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Business Informatics degree program. The examination performance can be a written exam or an individual oral examination.
